title.narrative: Greater Mekong Subregion Highway Modernization Project

description.narrative: The project will improve transport conditions along Myanmar's East-West Economic Corridor (EWEC) and North-South Economic Corridor (NSEC) by (i) improving about 99 km of GMS highways, (ii) improving the safety of the Yangon-Mandalay expressway, and (iii) preparing detailed designs for other highway projects on the GMS corridors. The highways to be improved under the project are the Bago-Thanlyin highway and the Yangon-Mandalay expressway. The highways to be designed under the project are the Yangon-Pathein highway and a new Bago-Kyaikto highway.

description.narrative: Efficiency and safety of road traffic along the GMS EWEC and NSEC in Myanmar improved

Road crash fatality rate on Yangon-Mandalay expressway reduced by 10% (2016 baseline: 270 fatalities per billion vehicle-km) Achievement: 270 fatalities Progress/Status: Activities on hold due to MYA situation. Data Source: Project completion report, Road Transport Administration Department data Baseline value: 270 fatalities

Road freight transport costs on project highway sections reduced by 12% Achievement: $.07 per ton-km Progress/Status: Activities on hold due to MYA situation. Data Source: Project completion report Baseline value: $.07 per ton-km

Travel time on project highway sections reduced by 50% Achievement: 1.8 mins per km Progress/Status: Activities on hold due to MYA situation. Data Source: Project completion report Baseline value: 1.8 minutes per km

Q4 2020: DED recruitment for Bago-Kyaikto is at contract negotiation stage. Expected completion of recruitment is in January 2021. The first-ranked firm, Sambo Engineering Co. Ltd. was invited for contract negotiations on 25 January 2021.
Q3 2020: DED recruitment for Bago-Kyaikto is at Submission 2 stage. Expected completion of recruitment is in Nov 2020.
Q2 2020: DED recruitment for Bago-Kyaikto is at Submission 2 stage. 5 shortlisted firms submitted technical proposals. Expected completion of recruitment is 31 Oct 2020. As of 30 June 2020, progress of DED for Yangon-Pathein is 68.4%.
